title: Grateful Dead Live at Stanley Theatre on 1972-09-27

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy September ’72 show featuring a smoking Dark Star→Cumberland, stellar Bird Song and flawless Jerry Garcia guitar work.
ai_review.review: The Vernon SBD capture is crisp and faithful, preserving one of the Dead’s most intense three‑night runs in 1972.  Highlights include a jazzy Dark Star that rockets into an epic Cumberland, a soaring Bird Song, tight China Cat → Rider, and blistering Jerry solos; the first set kicks off with a magical Morning Dew.  A few reviewers note sloppy vocals on Casey Jones and one out‑of‑tune complaint, but overall the performance is celebrated as a top‑tier show.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating ~4.73 across 22 reviews, with overwhelming praise for both musical performance and recording quality; only isolated negative comments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Vernon SBD is described as fine/crisp; no significant drop‑outs or balance issues mentioned.  Minor complaints focus on performance (tuning, vocals) rather than the recording itself.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
poor_songs: Casey Jones (sloppy vocals and solo mistake noted)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A powerful first set that opens with Morning Dew and builds through tight jams, followed by a second set dominated by an epic Dark Star→Cumberland sequence and a series of high‑impact songs; the pacing stays engaging throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Blistering, lightning‑fast guitar work especially in the Dark Star jam; minor slip on Casey Jones solo noted.
band_member_comments.Phil: Provides jazzy rhythmic foundation and “jazzy rhythms” that lift the Dark Star and other jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's jazz‑savvy keyboards are highlighted as a key element of the Dark Star’s middle section.
